en.t: The next day, the Buddhist service continued.

units.source_text: 紫夫人因昨日破例起身一整天，今天非常疲劳，便躺卧着。

en.t: Because Lady Murasaki had unusually stayed up all day the day before, she was extremely tired today and lay resting.

units.source_text: 多年以来，每逢兴会，诸人都来参与，表演舞乐。

en.t: For many years, whenever there was a festive gathering, everyone had come to take part and perform dances and music.

units.source_text: 其人个个容姿优美，才艺超群。

en.t: Each of them was graceful in appearance and outstanding in talent and accomplishment.

units.source_text: 紫夫人看了这光景，听了琴笛之声，觉得今日是最后一次了，

en.t: As Lady Murasaki looked at this scene and listened to the sounds of koto and flute, she felt that today would be the last time,

units.source_text: 便对于向来不甚注目的人也仔细观看，不胜感慨。

en.t: and so she gazed carefully even at people she had never paid much attention to before, overcome with feeling.

units.source_text: 何况看到同辈诸夫人——她们过去每逢四时游宴，互相会面，

en.t: How much more so when she saw the ladies of her own rank, whom in the past she had met whenever there were seasonal outings and banquets,

units.source_text: 胸中虽怀竞争之心，表面总是和睦相处——

en.t: and who, though they harbored rivalry in their hearts, had always outwardly lived together in harmony,

units.source_text: 尽管她们谁都不能长久在世，然而毕竟只有我一人将最先消灭得影迹全无。

en.t: though none of them can remain long in this world, in the end I alone will be the first to vanish without a trace.
Thinking this over again and again, she was endlessly sorrowful.

units.source_text: 法事圆满之后，诸人各自归家，紫夫人想起此次是永别，不胜痛惜。

en.t: After the service was completed, everyone returned home, and Lady Murasaki, thinking that this was a final farewell, was filled with painful regret.
